AKA the stuff that came easy to you as a kid.

Is that every form of "relaxing" in our society is SMASHING our minds with serotonin and dopamine.

TikTok. Video games. Drinking. WATCHING sports.

If you're doing these to relax, your mind is never at rest.

Like a dude spending every waking minute in a strip club. You'll become numb to things that used to drive you wild. Your motivation to chase plummets. 

When you relax, you have to actually relax and empty the mental bucket.

Drop it all. Read. Pick up an instrument. Lift. Keep your phone in a drawer far away from you. DEPRIVE yourself of the easy serotonin and dopamine.

All that gusto you used to have as a kid will come right back. Then USE the drive on what matters. AKA the thing, the work. Then ACTUALLY relax again.

99% of people are on a treadmill. They do low-focus, low-creativity, ass work... Then get home and scroll, eat sugar, play video games/scroll/watch Fox News/CNN, wank, binge Netflix and repeat.

Like the guy in the strip club, they can no longer enjoy the "curves" of life because they're in overdrive... staring at ass and tits 24/7.

You're not getting old or dull or necessarily suffering from ADHD.

Your brain just hasn't had a breather in years.

They are building this with Jev. A tiny AI model that doesn’t write. It just picks the right component in milliseconds.

4 repos to steal from:

> Shapeshift - one input that morphs into the right UI as you type: event card, checklist, timer, color picker, poll. One Jev call answers 14 questions in parallel. Runs offline without an account
bun install && bun dev
-> https://t.co/DS8kDhMnEQ

> json-render by Vercel Labs - generative UI from your own component catalog. Its experimental Jev mode picks which components and actions the screen should contain
Try it: https://t.co/rrKOFFJyaY -> "Jev (Experimental)"
-> https://t.co/8L5Pil2BAD

> unclutter by Kitze - a browser extension where Jev decides element by element what's clutter and wipes it off the page
-> https://t.co/mE9xkOqe1L

> jev-canvas - draw on a tldraw canvas with your voice and a pointing finger. Jev decides the action, the target and where it goes
-> https://t.co/v9B1L1yWnw

Here's why it works: Jev never generates your UI. It only chooses from components you already built. 

Your design system stays intact, and the model can't hallucinate a broken button.

The designer's job is shifting from drawing every screen to building the pieces and letting the interface pick.

More Jev projects: https://t.co/iWGEjUzf3V
